result:
All 11 DS pages are now on the section-rows layout in Figma, and I landed the task. The report is `kit/ds-rows.md`, committed by path.

- **Layout:** each section is a row with its title and description in a 400-wide left column and the existing specimens moved (not copied) into the right. Every node id is kept, so the Index still works.
- **Template choice:** I used the same auto layout, not a template instance, because a slot can't hold moved nodes.
- **Reactions:** 0 before and 0 after on the nine pages I counted. I did not count Elements or Icons; I only moved nodes there.
- **Side fixes:**
  - Single-stat block for 280 sidebars: `277:104073`.
  - Overview thumbnails: now 314 high, so none are clipped.
  - Stat master: gained a 1 px stroke, so it reads on the gray rail.
- **Left over:**
  - The three-phone rows render as two phones plus one full-width one.
  - Pages are taller (Elements went from 5773 to 8673).
  - I screenshot-checked only Buttons, Elements, Inputs & controls, 3 Sections and the Icons Core set. The other pages were checked by script and measured heights.
- **Not done:** I skipped the review step (`Server/review.mjs`) because the change is Figma-only. There is no kit readme, so nothing links the report yet; it is reachable only by its path.
